title: Juicy Malaysian Tofu Curry
description: A flavorful and spicy Malaysian curry dish featuring tofu and iceberg lettuce, perfect for a solo dinner, and is vegan-friendly.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the shredded lettuce and cook until wilted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over steamed rice or noodles.
